caption:
Forgiveness: the message Allah wants His servants to hear

Allah commands that this be told to His servants. Whatever you carried into today, turn back to Him.

Surah Al-Hijr 15:49

Send this to someone who thinks they have gone too far.

#forgiveness #istighfar #ghafoor #surahhijr #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
